cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative per-object allocations, not measured per-object success rates. Each method mean is matched to 100 * (Rotation SR + Flipping SR) / 2 from tro_revision/experiment.tex, tab:all_data. Foam brick is highest and Stanford bunny is lowest (ties permitted for zero rates). Numeric labels show the actual allocated percentages. Zero values use thin colored baseline markers.
